name: ark
description: ARK — AI decision intelligence, AI economics, secure AI operations.

scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @ark/core && npm run build --workspace @ark/db && npm run build --workspace @ark/ui && npm run build --workspace @ark/sdk
scripts.setup: npm run build:packages && npm run db:push && npm run db:seed
scripts.dev:my-ai-api: bash -c 'cd my-ai && PYTHONPATH=packages/core/src python3 -m uvicorn services.api.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8472'
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @ark/consumer && npm run build --workspace @ark/business && npm run build --workspace @ark/control
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @ark/core && npm run test --workspace @ark/db && npm run test --workspace @ark/sdk && node --test deploy/runtime.test.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types --test apps/consumer/src/lib/my-ai-proxy.test.ts
